name: Original paper
rationale: The previous warm neutral, retained as the control. Against ceramic it is separated more by warmth than by depth.
tradeoff: Its pale value keeps the slide light but may make its boundary too quiet beside the new site surface.

name: Warmer ivory
rationale: More yellow warmth and a little more depth make the paper visibly separate from cool ceramic without making the reading field dark.
tradeoff: The warmer cast can influence the apparent colour of imagery and may feel more traditional than intended.

name: Deeper parchment
rationale: A deeper warm field gives the strongest tonal separation of these papers. The surrounding ceramic stays visibly outside the slide.
tradeoff: The stronger material suggestion may become too sepia or aged; contrast alone does not make it the right character.

name: Mineral paper
rationale: A muted green-grey, deliberately deep enough to distinguish it from ceramic. It tests a cooler, more contemporary paper impression.
tradeoff: Its green cast may feel like a coloured interface surface rather than paper. It must earn its place beside the warmer alternatives.
